subject: Data Engineering
title: Reverse ETL
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Reverse ETL.

hook.text: Your warehouse has a perfect customer score. But the sales team needs it inside Salesforce.

buildup.text: Reverse ETL pushes data from the warehouse back into operational tools like CRMs and ad platforms.

discovery.text: Tools like Census and Hightouch sync warehouse tables to SaaS apps on a schedule.

twist.text: Reverse ETL turns the warehouse into a source of truth that powers actions, not just reports.

climax.text: Data that stays in the warehouse only creates charts. Data that moves back out creates revenue.

punchline.text: The warehouse isn't the end. It's the beginning.

quiz.question: What does Reverse ETL do?
options: Pushes warehouse data back into operational tools
